01 — Catamaran Tour
October 15 · The Day Before Your Wedding

A morning on the water the day before your wedding — great food, open bar, and the Central Pacific coastline. I found two beautiful options in different locations, each with its own character. Both work perfectly for your group of 23.

Marina Pez Vela · Manuel Antonio

Why Manuel Antonio
  • One of Costa Rica's most celebrated destinations — scenic, bucket-list coastline

Make a day of it — Manuel Antonio is about an hour from the villa. Guests who want more can visit Manuel Antonio National Park before the tour, or have dinner at one of the restaurants in Manuel Antonio after. It's well worth the trip for those who haven't been.

02 — Adventure Day at Vista Los Sueños

Gabrielle and Trevor, you mentioned wanting to do a zipline — Vista Los Sueños Adventure Park is just 40 minutes from the villa and is exactly the right place for it. The idea is that everyone heads there together, and each person picks what they feel like doing. Anyone who wants to join you on the zipline is very welcome. And for guests who'd rather do something different, there's a full menu of activities on-site — from horseback riding and chocolate experiences to canyoning and ATV trails. Transport from the villa is included in all prices.

Your pick · Zipline
Zipline / Canopy
Fly through the Costa Rican rainforest on 10 cables across 12 platforms with ocean views of Herradura Bay. Tractor ride up the mountain, bilingual guides, wildlife spotting along the way.
$95 per person
✓ Transport from villa included
Most popular combo
Zipline + Horseback
Soar through the canopy, then ride through the rainforest down to pristine natural pools for a swim. A perfect half-day for anyone who wants the best of both worlds.
$145 per person
✓ Transport from villa included
Popular combo
Zipline + ATV + Waterfalls
Fly the canopy then take the jungle trails by ATV — river crossings, dirt paths, and hidden waterfalls included. The most adventurous combo on the menu.
$120 per person
✓ Transport from villa included
Popular combo
Zipline + Chocolate Tour
Combine the canopy with a guided chocolate experience — Costa Rican cacao varieties, history, tasting, and making your own chocolate. Great for those who want adventure with a softer side.
$85 per person
✓ Transport from villa included
